name: harz-universal-app-contract-audit-phase1-20261008
description: Phase 1 audit of the 81-app PWA fleet against the HARZ Universal App Contract (row 86). Automated presence screening: 0 dead roots, 2 full pass, 47 presence-pass with unverified shell, 32 with gaps (~16 apps never register their service worker, ~11 missing manifest.json, ~7 missing Apple install tags). Confirmed violation: HARZ Circle + HARZ Proof serve sw.js but never register it. Phase 2 browser death tests pending; fixes await approval.
